benefitsSection.title: Move fast without breaking the things that matter.
benefitsSection.lead: AI is a productivity multiplier, not a replacement for engineering judgment. We combine proven [AI-assisted development practices](https://www.ssw.com.au/rules/rules-to-better-ai-development) with the governance, quality standards, and Scrum discipline that enterprise teams expect.

items.title: Faster delivery
items.description: AI-assisted development helps compress weeks of work into days. We can spec, scaffold, and ship features in tighter loops without cutting corners.

items.title: Enterprise-grade quality
items.description: Every change is backed by code reviews, automated tests, security baselines, and architectural oversight from senior consultants.

items.title: North American communication
items.description: A dedicated North America-based Scrum Master runs your standups, sprint reviews, and stakeholder updates in your time zone.

items.title: Scrum-led delivery
items.description: Two-week sprints, demoable increments, and transparent burndowns. You always know what is being built, what is next, and when it will be ready.

items.title: Flexible team structure
items.description: Scale up or down with senior architects, hands-on engineers, and cost-effective delivery resources as the work demands.

items.title: Cost-effective scaling
items.description: Blended delivery models give you senior oversight where it matters most and efficient throughput where it makes sense.

servicesSection.title: From a rapid prototype to a critical system of record.
servicesSection.lead: We work across the full lifecycle, from a Friday afternoon idea to a multi-year enterprise platform, with the same discipline and senior technical leadership.

items.title: AI-assisted software development
items.description: Production-grade applications built with the [best AI-assisted development workflow](https://www.ssw.com.au/rules/ai-assisted-development-workflow), including specs, code generation, QA, and review. Senior engineers guide the tooling so what you ship is fast to deliver, clean to maintain, and ready to scale.

items.title: Legacy app modernization
items.description: Modernize aging .NET, WinForms, and on-prem systems into secure, scalable cloud architectures without disrupting the business.

items.title: Custom business applications
items.description: Line-of-business tools that fit your operations, not the other way around. Built to integrate with your existing systems and workflows.

items.title: Technical consulting and architecture
items.description: Senior architects help you make high-leverage technical decisions before they become expensive to change.

howSection.title: A predictable path from first call to live software.
howSection.lead: No discovery theater. No vague proposals. You will see a working increment in the first sprint.

steps.title: Discovery call
steps.description: A 30-minute conversation with a senior consultant. We discuss your goals, constraints, risks, and what success looks like.

steps.title: Solution design
steps.description: We scope the architecture, timeline, and team structure. You get a clear proposal, not a moving target.

steps.title: Rapid AI-assisted build
steps.description: Engineers ship features using AI-augmented workflows. Code is reviewed, tested, and deployed continuously. For early validation, see SSW's rule on using [AI tools in prototype development](https://www.ssw.com.au/rules/ai-for-prototype-development).

steps.title: Scrum-led iteration
steps.description: Two-week sprints. Live demos. Transparent backlog. We iterate with you until the software is in production.

whySection.title: A consulting partner built for the next decade of software.
whySection.lead: SSW has spent more than three decades shipping enterprise software for demanding teams. Now we are bringing that engineering discipline to AI-native delivery for clients across the U.S. and Canada.

rows.title: Experienced, right-sized teams
rows.description: Senior architects, hands-on engineers, and dedicated Scrum Masters who have shipped complex software for banking, healthcare, government, and Fortune 500 clients. Right-sized for your phase and your budget.

rows.title: Proven Scrum process
rows.description: Two-week sprints, working demos, and transparent commitments. Predictability is built into the process.

rows.title: Practical AI adoption
rows.description: We use AI tooling that works in real production environments and skip the parts that do not. No hype, just measurable throughput. We also follow practical guidance such as avoiding [automation bias](https://www.ssw.com.au/rules/avoid-automation-bias), so AI outputs are reviewed, challenged, and owned by the team.

rows.title: Strong engineering standards
rows.description: Public coding rules, automated checks, mandatory code review, and a culture of continuous improvement. We also use AI where it helps quality, including [automated code reviews on GitHub](https://www.ssw.com.au/rules/automatic-code-reviews-github).

rows.title: Balance of quality, speed, and cost
rows.description: Quality, speed, and cost need to work together. Most consultancies optimize for one. We help you move faster while keeping engineering standards high.

items.question: How should I choose an AI-assisted software development partner?

paragraphs.text: Choose a partner that has shipped production software, not just demos. Look for strong engineering practices, transparent delivery, and senior people who stay engaged through the entire build.

AI tooling matters less than the discipline behind it. SSW combines AI-assisted workflows with more than three decades of enterprise consulting experience, so you get speed and accountability together.

items.question: What are the benefits of working with SSW versus building in-house?

paragraphs.text: Hiring senior engineers takes months. We start within two weeks with a complete team of engineers, Scrum Master, and architect. No ramp time, no recruiting overhead, no risk of a bad hire on a critical project.
You keep the code, the IP, and the practices. We hand off cleanly when you are ready to run it yourselves.

items.question: How does SSW combine AI speed with enterprise quality?

paragraphs.text: Through process. AI accelerates coding, not judgment. Every change runs through the same pipeline: spec, code review, automated test, staged deploy. Senior engineers stay on the loop end to end.
The result is software that ships fast and stays shipped.
